slides.title: SATQUERY AI
text_blocks: Multimodal Input: Supports Optical, SAR, and Thermal remote-sensing imagery.
Natural-Language Queries: Users can ask questions about satellite imagery using
simple text.
AI-Powered Analysis: A Vision-Language Model (LLaVA) interprets both the user’s
query and satellite image content.
Geospatial Grounding: SAM / CLIP-BLIP components connect the AI's response to
specific regions in the image.
Interactive Map Output: Results are displayed on a React + Leaflet/OpenLayers
interface with relevant areas highlighted.
Geospatial Backend: FastAPI + PostgreSQL/PostGIS manages queries, imagery and
spatial results.
Key Innovation: Combines Vision-Language AI + multimodal remote sensing
+ geospatial grounding in one query-driven workflow

text_blocks: Input: Optical, SAR & Thermal satellite imagery + natural-language query.
AI Analysis: LLaVA processes the image and understands the user's query.

Backend Processing: FastAPI + PostgreSQL/PostGIS manages AI, imagery & spatial data.
Interactive Output: React + Leaflet/OpenLayers displays highlighted regions and AI-generated insights.

slides.title: FEASIBILITY AND VIABILITY
text_blocks: Technical Feasibility: Uses existing AI/remote-sensing technologies such as LLaVA, SAM/CLIP-BLIP, FastAPI and PostGIS, making implementation practical.
Data Feasibility: Supports readily available Optical, SAR and Thermal satellite imagery with geospatial metadata.
Scalability: Modular architecture allows additional satellite sensors, AI models and GIS layers to be integrated later.
Cost & Deployment: Can be developed using open-source frameworks and cloud/GPU infrastructure, reducing development cost.
Practical Viability: Natural-language interaction and location-grounded visual results can support applications in disaster monitoring, urban planning, agriculture and environmental analysis.
Sustainability: The same platform can be reused for multiple geospatial use cases without redesigning the complete system.

challenge_mitigation_pairs.challenge: Large satellite images and high data volume
challenge_mitigation_pairs.mitigation: Use image tiling / sliding-window inference for efficient processing.
Use model quantisation and optimized inference on GPU/cloud infrastructure.

challenge_mitigation_pairs.challenge: Different characteristics of Optical, SAR and Thermal data

challenge_mitigation_pairs.mitigation: Use SAM / CLIP-BLIP to verify and localize relevant regions.

slides.title: IMPACT AND BENEFITS
text_blocks: Faster Decision-Making: Converts complex satellite imagery into quick, understandable, location-based insights.
For Government & Agencies: Supports disaster management, urban planning and infrastructure monitoring.
Environmental Impact: Helps monitor temperature hotspots, land-use changes, vegetation and environmental risks.
Economic Benefits: Reduces dependence on manual satellite-image analysis, saving time and operational effort.
Accessible Technology: Natural-language queries make remote-sensing analysis easier for non-experts.
Scalable Impact: One platform can support multiple domains such as agriculture, disaster response, environment and smart cities.
